outing.hero_prompt_english: Yexian Pagoda scenic area on the edge of Miyun town: a small pale historic pagoda silhouette on a low wooded hill, the lower Puzhao Temple courtyard and simple tiled roofs in the foreground. Adult visitors remain on a formal lower paved courtyard. Golden autumn foliage, clear separation between distant hill and accessible ground-level scene; no climb or rides. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
